query: Which country won the most gold medals at the 2026 Winter Olympics in Milan and Cortina?
answer: Norway won the most gold medals at the 2026 Winter Olympics in Milan and Cortina, with 18. It also won the most medals overall, 41 (18 gold, 12 silver, 11 bronze) [1][2]. Those 18 golds are a record for one Winter Games, beating the 16 Norway won in Beijing in 2022 [2][3]. The United States came second with 12 golds and 33 medals in total [1][3].
